response.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: Inner join between scanconservation and sites on zoneref = zoneregistry; zoneref is NOT NULL with a foreign key, so every conservation record matches a site and none are dropped.
A NULL insurstat forms its own group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), and the share denominator is the total count over all groups including the NULL group.
Only genuinely NULL insurance status is treated as missing; empty strings, if any, would be a separate group.
